# Move two packages' generate flags into one muxt.json with package_defaults,
# then generate both with a single muxt generate at the top.

muxt generate
! stdout .
muxt generate -v
cmp stdout want-stdout.txt
exec go test ./...

# A flag in a directory with an entry is rejected, and nothing is written.
cd workspace
! muxt generate --output-htmx
cmpenv stderr ../want-err.txt

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"package_defaults": {
		"output_htmx": true
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m": {
			"use_receiver_type": "Server"
		},
		"example.com/m/workspace": {
			"use_receiver_type": "T"
		}
	}
}
-- want-stdout.txt --
example.com/m/workspace
generating handler for pattern GET /{$}
wrote template_routes.go: 1 route
example.com/m
generating handler for pattern GET /{$}
wrote template_routes.go: 1 route
-- want-err.txt --
Error: configure generate with fields in $WORK/muxt.json instead of flags
-- server.go --
package m

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"

	"example.com/m/workspace"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFS, "*"))

type Server struct {
	Workspace workspace.T
}

func (Server) Home() string { return "home" }
-- home.gohtml --
{{define "GET /{$} Home()"}}<p>{{.Result}}</p>{{end}}
-- server_test.go --
package m

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestHome(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil))

	if got, want := rec.Result().StatusCode, http.StatusOK; got != want {
		t.Errorf("GET / status = %d, want %d", got, want)
	}
	if body := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(body, "<p>home</p>") {
		t.Errorf("GET / body = %q, want it to contain <p>home</p>", body)
	}
}
-- workspace/workspace.go --
package workspace

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFS, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) Index() string { return "workspace" }
-- workspace/index.gohtml --
{{define "GET /{$} Index()"}}<p>{{.Result}}</p>{{end}}
-- workspace/workspace_test.go --
package workspace

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestIndex(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, T{})

	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil))

	if got, want := rec.Result().StatusCode, http.StatusOK; got != want {
		t.Errorf("GET / status = %d, want %d", got, want)
	}
	if body := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(body, "<p>workspace</p>") {
		t.Errorf("GET / body = %q, want it to contain <p>workspace</p>", body)
	}
}
